summary: Improve channel coverage, partner plans, and performance reviews with practical route-to-market training. Explore the five-day course.
lede: Route-to-market strategy helps channel managers, sales operations analysts, and partner managers design customer coverage across direct and indirect channels. The training covers mapping customer segments, comparing channel economics, assessing partner readiness, and coordinating joint plans, forecasts, and performance reviews. Practical exercises produce draft route-to-market maps, partner scorecards, channel assessments, and review packs to adapt to an organisation’s data and commercial priorities.
audienceIntro: This foundation course suits you if your role shapes customer coverage, supports indirect sales, or coordinates the partners and information behind channel execution.
prerequisites: No specific prerequisites required. Basic professional experience recommended.
